notes.title: Hentaimon Demo Update
notes.content:
Hentaimon Demo is going to receive an update from all the content that was made last year. This is a major update since it’ll contain tons of H-scenes and new maps and quests to explore.

[h1][b]New content[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Added new Hentaimon: Galga, Buzzazzy, Lansir, Pock, Etona, Megara, Mimika, Coropi, Smill 
[*] Added new Evolution: Faepih, Pixxaz, Gramm, Phlita, Beedra, Ploom, Erock 
[*] Added new maps: Route 2, Nirium Maze, Route 3, Tchurro Town and Insides, Mayor's Basement, Route 21, Route 4 
[*] Added more Mimika Fixed Spawns
[*] Added new main story quests
[*] Added New Sidequests
[*] Added an NPC that sells affinity items in Alibina
[*] Added unlimited time for the Pixel art Hentai Scenes(HOLD Z/CONFIRM to leave the scene) 
[*] Added an NPC that sells affinity items(Alibina Town) 
[*] Added indicators on skills telling if they scale with Physical damage or Magic damage
[*] Added Name Display upon entering the maps
[*] Added a pop-up warning whenever you reach a skill at the required level to start the evolution quest of a Hentaimon
[*] Added constant moans every time a Hentai Scene is active
[*] Added an NPC that will take you directly to the new content of the build 
[*] Added a feature where your Mom will give you Lunch from time to time when you visit the house
[*] Added Mom visuals 
[*] Added a keyboard config feature
[*] Added a simplified Hentaipedia 
[*] Added Character Quests
[*] Added music to Tchurro 
[*] Added the option to teleport from Alibina to other Save Statues
[*] Added new Hentai Scenes: Goma Hentai Scene 2; Galga Hentai Scene 1; Heera Scene 1; Buzzazzy Hentai Scene 1; Buzzazzy Hentai Scene 2; Goma Hentai Scene 3; Pixxi Hentai Scene 2; Aerih Hentai Scene 2; Photan Hentai Scene 3; Plumfur Hentai Scene 3; Pixxi Hentai Scene 3; Heera Hentai Scene 2; Kunim Hentai Scene 1; Kunina Hentai Scene 1; Flogge Hentai Scene 1 ; Floppa Hentai Scene 1 ; Ukisa Hentai Scene 1 ; Ukiki Hentai Scene 1 ; Pixxaz Hentai Scene 1; Gramm Hentai Scene 1 ; Faepih Hentai Scene 1 ; Phlita Hentai Scene 1 ; Ploom Hentai Scene 1 ; Beedra Hentai Scene 1 ; Aerih Hentai Scene 3 ; Kunim Hentai Scene 2 ; Flogge Hentai Scene 2 ; Ukisa Hentai Scene 2; Mimika Hentai Scene 1 ; Mimika Hentai Scene 2 ; Beesa Hentai Scene 3; Galga Hentai Scene 2; Pock Hentai Scene 2; Lansir Hentai Scene 2; Etona Hentai Scene 2; Coropi Hentai Scene 1; Coropi Hentai Scene 2; Pixxaz Hentai Scene 2; Gramm Hentai Scene 2; Faepih Hentai Scene 2; Smill Hentai Scene 1; Smill Hentai Scene 2; Erock Hentai Scene 1; Erock Hentai Scene 2; 
 
[*] Changed the forest NPCs to be only Photans, Plumfurs, and Beesas
[*] Changed the text box 
[*] Changed some SFXs 
[*] Changed the NPC battle system so you can't capture them
[*] Changed the Elemental Chart Visuals 
[*] Changed the position the Hentaimon are displayed in the Lab and while evolving
[*] Changed the content of some shops 
[*] Changed skill damage calculation for multiple skills 
[*] Changed the defeat penalty from "Game Over" to Respawn at your bed 
[*] Changed the way the starters evolve(the first evolution doesn't need a quest, but the second one does)
[*] Changed the affinity system cap
[/list]
[b]And we fixed a lot of bugs![/b]

We hope you enjoy this new update.
